items.text: 我横竖睡不着，仔细看了半夜，才从字缝里看出字来，满本都写着两个字是『吃人』！

errors.evidence: I could not sleep either way
errors.why: 横竖 means 'in any case, anyway'. 'Either way' is close but a little unnatural, and it is acceptable only as a near-synonym.

errors.evidence: make out the words between the lines
errors.why: 字缝 is the gaps between characters, though the reference accepts 'between the lines', so this is only a slight loss of precision.

items.text: 子曰：「學而時習之，不亦說乎？有朋自遠方來，不亦樂乎？人不知而不慍，不亦君子乎？」
